notes.title: Bardic: Quest for Love | The Big Update!
notes.notes:
Bardic: Quest for Love is an enchanting blend of Adventure and Dating Sim set in the magical city of Deepharbor. Playing as either Edmond or Edna, a humble bard fresh to the city of Deepharbor, they are suddenly tasked with running a tavern. Players must navigate the challenges of managing a struggling establishment while exploring the realms of love, adventure, and city life in the sprawling port city of Deepharbor.

FEATURES:
- 🍞Character Selection🍞
Pick which Bard twin you'd like to play as! (And choose your Pronouns!)
- 🍞Stat Customization🍞
Choose how you'd like to allocate your Stats! (Which affects how you'll do in with Dialogue Options!)
- 🍞Dialogue Options🍞
Choose dialogue options that will resonate with these heroes! (like in Real Life!)
Some dialogue options feature a dice roll! (Make sure to check which skills you're good at!)
- 🍞Walkable Overworld!🍞
Roam the map! Explore the great city of Deepharbor and pursue the Heroes whom you're interested in!
- 🍞Story Points, Side Stories, and Tavern Skills🍞
When you find a Hero, they'll either have a Story Point, Which advances you further with their route, Or you can play through a side-story, which gives you a Tavern Skill! (Useable in the Tavern Minigame!)
- 🍞Tavern Management Sim🍞
Choose your Heroes and their Skills, and Serve the Customers!

[previewyoutube=qmKMWMcjFTA;full][/previewyoutube]

Specifically in this BIG Update, we'd like to highlight:
- Inventory and Tavern Skills Improved Functionality (Though Special Skills don't work yet, we'll fix it this upcoming week!)
- Walkable Open Overworld
- Tweaks and Improvement to Story
- Tavern Management Sim Rework
- And an over all Systems Overhaul

notes.title: Final Major Update of Bardic: Quest for Love
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44677273/00b5733443787add1f024878e4aa24cdb6afdef2.png[/img]

Major Features:
Exploration and Tavern Management Sim are IMPLELEMNTED and DONE!!!

BUG FIXES and TWEAKs

[X] Action points vanish when simply clicking on a character (not dragging). Clicking on a character brings up their skills menu, but an action point is lost in the process.

[X] If you begin to drag a character elsewhere, then change your mind and place them back where they started, an action point is lost.

[X] If you drag a character onto an illegitimate part of the screen, such as a table, character snaps back to original location and an action point is lost.

[X] Action points are not even mentioned in the tutorial, much less explained.

[X] Sometimes one of the employee characters will levitate into the air when the "customers approach" screen pops up.

[X] The "Cost" listing in the skill menu is vague: does it cost SP or energy? 8b. Or... both? I saw Rile Up Crowd consume 4 points of both types, but the skill description makes no mention of this.

[X] Hector was unable to use Showboat when he had 2 energy and 4 SP.

[X] When Abigail casts Bandage, a screen pops up with four arrows pointing to four characters telling me to select a target. I have tried clicking the arrows as well as clicking the characters and nothing works. Bug appeared on multiple different rounds.

[X] When you click on character, you no longer can open the Action HUD. Instead, the SkillToggle (Exclamation mark) will be the only way to open the HUD. The size is also bigger
